title: Let your agent draw. We make sure the diagram works.
snippet:
Mermaid diagrams for your code, agents and products. One API call.

AI agents and chat tools
Language models write Mermaid well, but not perfectly. Validate what your model produced before your user sees it, repair it when it breaks, and render it to an image your chat or app can show.
Docs and CI pipelines
Render the diagrams in your docs to SVG, PNG or PDF at build time. Validate them in CI and fail the build on a broken diagram, before it ships.
From program to teammate
Offer diagrams in your product without running a browser farm. Create a stored diagram, keep its ID for later updates, and hand an edit URL or share invitation to a teammate.

## One request. A real answer.
bash
```
curl https://api.mermaid.ai/v1/render \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $MERMAID_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"code": "flowchart TD\n  A[Start] --> B[Done]", "format": "svg"}' \
-o diagram.svg
```
The response is the image itself, ready to write to disk.
## Mermaid is open source. Why use the API?
Nothing to host
Rendering Mermaid needs a headless browser. We run it, so you send one HTTP request.

Know your balance
A free endpoint tells your program what it has left and what each call costs. Out of credits says "buy"; too fast says "wait".

Mermaid is the open-source language and library that turns text into diagrams. Mermaid API is a hosted service that runs Mermaid for you: your program sends diagram code over HTTP and gets back a validation result, an image, or new diagram code.
No. Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans include a bigger allowance.
Costs depend on the operation and options; stored-diagram reads are free. Your monthly allowance is spent first, then any credits you have bought. See the current costs in [api.mermaid.ai/v1/docs](https://api.mermaid.ai/v1/docs); the free balance endpoint also returns your balance and endpoint costs. For high volume, contact sales.

title: MCP Server — Mermaid Chart
snippet:
The Mermaid MCP Server supports multiple transport modes, and **every tool call requires authentication** with a Mermaid account. Authentication is free — you can sign up for a free Mermaid account (the Basic tier) to get started. Authenticate automatically via **OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration** (for clients that support OAuth discovery, such as VS Code, Cursor, and Antigravity via `mcp-remote`), or manually by pasting a Mermaid token into your client configuration. See Authentication Setup below for details on both options.

Every tool call requires you to be logged in to your Mermaid account. Signing up is free — the Basic tier costs nothing.

title: What plans are available?
snippet:
Mermaid offers four plans:
- Basic — Free. 3 diagrams for individuals, 6 for team accounts, 15 AI credits.
- Plus — $10 per user per month (billed annually). Unlimited diagrams, 300 AI credits per year.
- Premium — $20 per user per month (billed annually). Unlimited diagrams, 2,000 AI credits, unlimited free viewer seats.
- Enterprise — Custom pricing. All Premium features plus SSO, a dedicated Customer Success Manager, custom contracts, and IP management.
All paid plans are billed **annually.** See the Pricing [page](https://mermaid.ai/web/pricing/) for full details.

title: Mermaid Flow: the visual builder for agentic workflows
snippet:
Today we’re launching Mermaid Flow, which lets you build agentic workflows as diagrams and then run them. We made it for the AI work that happens more than once, so you can build something a single time and trust it to run the same way every time after that.

All of this kept bringing us back to something we already knew. Our team maintains the open-source Mermaid project, and for years we’ve watched people use it to draw how a process is supposed to work. Often that diagram was the clearest description of the process anyone had, and the only thing missing was that it couldn’t actually do anything.

Mermaid Flow is available now at [mermaid.ai/flow](https://mermaid.ai/flow). The free plan includes 15 workflow runs a month, which is enough to see one of your own workflows work, and Premium includes 500 shared runs a month across your organization. Learn more [here](https://mermaid.ai/products/flow/).
